styleSelection.reason: Pure watercolor with no ink: broad warm-cream and cool-cerulean value planes carry the curved ship hulls, spars, anchor, and harbor reflections through layered wet-on-dry washes and late dark glazes.

families.referenceCue: Sunlit white hull flank on the right: warm cream paper carries the lit planes while pale cool blue-grey diagonal rigging shadows and crisp dark hawsehole accents sit wet-on-dry over the dry ground.
Curving central bow in cool blue-violet and cerulean shadow, graded down to a deeper slate-blue waterline band with a dark port accent and warm sienna-ochre trim along the bow curve.
Left-side spars, rigging, and hanging anchor: warm ochre and sienna timber diagonals and reserved pale anchor flukes set against cool blue-grey shadow planes.
Deepest umber-ultramarine shadow under the bow and its dark reflections across the lower-center water, built in late dark glazes over the dried underwash.
Lower-right turquoise-green harbor water with broken pale warm ripples, crossed by the diagonal burnt-sienna and ochre mooring line dropping from the right hull into the water.

reserves.reason: Brightest sunlit cream hull gleam below the upper rigging cast shadow
Upper sunlit cream hull highlight plane on the starboard flank
